name: Movilla Abbey
text: Movilla Abbey (Irish: Mainistir Mhaigh Bhile "Monastery of the Plain of the Notable Tree") in Newtownards, County Down, Northern Ireland, is believed to have been one of Ulster's and Ireland's most important monasteries. Movilla should not be confused with Moville in County Donegal.

depictions.name: Movilla Abbey
depictions.text: Movilla Abbey was an abbey on the eastern peninsula of Ulster, Ireland.
